note: State-of-the-Nation Address of 2025-11-10: crime counts only (overall crime down 8.2 per cent in 2024 on 2023; 14,020 gender-based violence cases recorded by the Botswana Police Service in 2024) and the absorption of 874 special constables; no police information system is named and nothing is said of how stations record.
